fusions.name: Light Fingers
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that deals 8 damage, up to 1.8 times that at maximum range. It costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Treetop Barrage
fusions.desc: Pelts the enemy ahead with 3 spread-out missiles, each dealing 7 damage and stunning for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Branch Hop
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away. Using it increases your movement speed by 15% for 4s, and you gain 10% dodge chance.

fusions.name: Quick Pockets
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you regain 6 stamina. Once every 5 seconds.
